title: optimize quant kernels: INT8/FP8 smoothquant + dequant fusion; scheduling & KV-cache warmup
author: Diego Ramos
description: Motivation: reduce serving cost and improve tail latency for quantized models (INT8/FP8) by optimizing fused kernel paths (smoothquant + dequant fusion), improving kernel scheduling heuristics to increase GPU occupancy for short/variable sequences, and stabilizing KV-cache warmup for continuous batching. This PR introduces micro-optimizations in CUDA/MLIR kernels, a new fusion path that merges smoothquant scaling and dequantization in a single pass for common transformer blocks, scheduler heuristics to prefer higher-occupancy launches for small-batch, long-context requests, and a background KV-cache warmup that hides latency for cold caches. Changeset summary: single-commit squash of kernel refactor + scheduler + tests; added perf benchmarks and regression tests to perf-canary; integrated runtime flag to toggle new fusion paths; fallback to safe (non-fused) path on numeric instability. Checklist: - [x] Kernel fusion: smoothquant + dequant fused execution - [x] INT8/FP8 codepaths validated with reference float32 outputs (max 0.6% relative diff on top-k logits) - [x] Scheduler heuristics added (occupancy-based decision rules) - [x] KV-cache warmup background worker + correctness tests - [x] Unit + integration tests added - [x] Perf benchmarks (throughput & p99 latency) attached Notes: The fused path is enabled under runtime config quant.fusion.enabled=true by default for supported GPUs; safe fallback remains available. We observed varying improvements by model/sequence length; see release_notes for numbers.
commits: a1b2c3d: refactor quant kernels: introduce fused_smoothquant_dequant kernel and platform abstraction
d4e5f6a: micro-optimizations: swap memory layout for GEMM inputs, reduce shared memory footprint, manual unrolls for tail dims
b7c8d9e: scheduler: occupancy-based launch planner + improved continuous-batching heuristics
f0e1d2c: kvcache: background warmup worker + instrumentation
c3d4e5f: tests: numeric stability tests, perf benchmarks in perf-canary, unit tests for fallback paths
e6f7a8b: docs: add runtime config notes and troubleshooting tips for quant fusion
review_comments: Lena Kim: Left a couple of comments on kernel bounds checks; suggested adding explicit FP8 exponent overflow checks. Response: added overflow clamp and unit test (see c3d4e5f).

Anya Patel: Requested microbenchmark numbers on A100 vs H100 and for 512/2048 context lengths. Response: attached perf-canary CSV and added benchmarking script. Results: A100: throughput +18% (2048), p99 -9%; H100: throughput +32% (2048), p99 -12%.

Marcus Li: Asked about numeric regressions on top-k outputs for generation. Response: added numeric stability test that compares top-10 logits to float32 baseline with tolerance, and added runtime flag to force safe path per-model if needed.
CI Bot: Build failed on first run due to flake in continuous_batcher; fix pushed in d4e5f6a and CI passed on re-run.
merge_details: squash and merge by Lena Kim; merge commit includes test artifacts and perf CSV; rollout started on canary for Dedicated clusters.
release_notes: Performance: Improve throughput for quantized INT8/FP8 models by up to 32% on H100 and up to 18% on A100 for long-context workloads (2048 tokens). Latency: p99 improvements up to 12% observed. Stability: enabled runtime fallback to safe dequant path on numerical instability. Ops: new runtime config quant.fusion.enabled (default true) and quant.fusion.force_safe_for_model to disable per-model.
notes: Scoped rollout: enabled on 10% Dedicated traffic for 48 hours; monitoring dashboards added to Redwood Console (per-model quant fusion metrics, kvcache hit/warmup). If regressions detected, ops can toggle quant.fusion.enabled=false globally.
